graduationPage.title: Graduation
graduationPage.hint: Confirm degree conferral for students who have completed their program. Confirming graduation sets the student's status to Graduated and issues a certificate — this cannot be undone from here.
graduationPage.empty: No students are currently Graduation Eligible.
graduationPage.confirmDialog: Confirm graduation for {{name}}? This sets their status to Graduated and issues a certificate. This cannot be undone from here.
graduationPage.financeHoldError: Cannot graduate — outstanding balance of {{amount}} must be cleared first.

conflictsPage.title: Conflict Detection
conflictsPage.noActiveIssues: No active issues — everything looks clear.

detail.issueGone: This issue no longer applies — it may already be resolved. Try re-scanning.
detail.clashDuplicate: Same course — likely a duplicate entry
detail.noRoomsAvailable: No other rooms are free at this exact day and time.
detail.noTimesAvailable: No free times found for this room today.
detail.confirmRemoveDuplicate: Remove this session from the timetable? This can't be undone.
detail.toastResolved: Conflict resolved — re-checked the timetable for new clashes.

usersPage.title: User Management
usersPage.searchAriaLabel: Search by name, email, or ID number
usersPage.cannotChangeOwnRole: Use another admin account to change your own role
usersPage.confirmDelete: Delete user {{name}}? This cannot be undone.
usersPage.departmentScopeTitle: This role only sees and manages this department's data
usersPage.collegeScopeTitle: This role sees and manages every department in this college

toast.needDepartmentFirst: Create a department first — this role must be scoped to one.
toast.needCollegeFirst: Create a college first — this role must be scoped to one.

createAccountForm.tempPasswordHint: A temporary password is generated automatically — you'll see it right after creating the account. There's no email; share it with them directly.

toast.pickDepartment: Pick a department for a faculty account.
toast.pickCollege: Pick a college for a Dean account.

resetPasswordForm.hint: This immediately replaces the user's current password. There is no email notification — tell them the new password directly.

validation.minLength: Password must be at least 8 characters.

accountCredentials.hint: Copy or export these now — temporary passwords are shown only once. Share them with each person directly; they'll be forced to set a new password on first login.

export.title: Export backup
export.hint: Saves everything — courses, timetables, exams, user accounts, and enrollments — into a single file. Do this regularly (for example at the end of each week) and keep the file on a USB drive or another computer, so the data survives if this machine fails.

restore.title: Restore from backup
restore.hint: Loads a previously exported backup file. This overwrites all current data with what the backup contains — you will be asked to confirm before anything happens.

confirmRestore.message: Restore "{{fileName}}"? This replaces ALL current data — every course, timetable, user account, and enrollment — with the contents of that backup. Anything added or changed since the backup was made will be lost. The app reloads when the restore finishes, and you may need to log in again.
confirmRestore.label: Restore backup

toast.exported: Backup exported — keep the file somewhere safe, like a USB drive or shared folder.

systemReset.title: System Reset
systemReset.hint: Permanently deletes all operational data — courses, timetables, exams, enrollments, students, teachers, notifications, admissions, and finance records — while keeping the schema, every Super Admin account, and your institution's branding/config intact. This cannot be undone.
systemReset.confirmMessage: This permanently deletes all operational data — courses, timetables, exams, enrollments, students, teachers, notifications, admissions, and finance records. Super Admin accounts, the database schema, and institution settings are kept. This cannot be undone.

toast.successWithBackup: System reset complete. Backup saved as "{{fileName}}" — reloading…

result.successNoBackup: Reset complete. No backup was taken.

dataMigrationPage.title: Data Migration Center
dataMigrationPage.hint: Import data from another database, or a CSV/Excel file, into this system. Nothing existing is ever changed or deleted — every import only adds new rows, and a full snapshot is taken before anything is written so an import can always be undone.

history.label: Label
history.empty: No migrations yet — start a new one to import data.

connect.title: Connect to the source
connect.label: Label
connect.newConnection: Or connect to a new database

validate.title: Validate
validate.ok: Everything looks good — you're ready for a dry run.

dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.hint: Checks every row against the mapping without writing anything to the database. Counts below are estimated — the real import may differ slightly if the source data changes before you run it.
dryRun.summary: Estimated {{estimated}} rows ready to import, {{errors}} would fail.
dryRun.failed: The dry run failed. You can try again.

import.title: Import
import.hint: Writes the mapped rows into the database. A full backup snapshot is taken first, so this can be rolled back afterward if needed.
import.confirmCancel: Stop this import? Rows already written stay in place — nothing already imported is undone by cancelling.

report.title: Report
report.confirmRollback: Undo this migration? Every row it inserted will be deleted. If that can't be done cleanly, the database is restored from the snapshot taken just before this import instead — which replaces the ENTIRE database with how it looked at that moment, undoing any other changes made since. This cannot be undone.
report.rollbackToastOk: Migration rolled back — the rows it inserted have been removed.
report.rollbackToastSnapshot: Migration rolled back by restoring the pre-import snapshot — the entire database was reverted to that point in time.
